The '''Murkhana system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]], near the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]].

==History==
Murkhana was the headquarters of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was located near [[Weytta]], the home planet of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Roan Shryne]].
